rsaAes.importHelp: Obtain PUBLIC KEY or RSA PUBLIC KEY PEM through trusted server administration. Never paste a private key/certificate or trust a live connection's key automatically. Conversion does not establish identity or save: verify the full pin, then explicitly Save.

The RFB-issued RSA key is not a trusted host identity; SRP verifies the account and server proof, while SSH protects the full VNC session. The SSH host key identifies the selected endpoint but cannot rule out an onward proxy.
security.appleSrpHelp: Requires a saved SSH connection to the Mac and an RFB destination of 127.0.0.1 or ::1. SRP verifies the account and server proof; SSH protects the full VNC session. The SSH host key identifies the selected endpoint, but cannot rule out an onward proxy.
security.appleVncPasswordHelp: Optional Mac VNC password (1–8 printable ASCII bytes). Bare type 2 does not verify server identity or encrypt the desktop. Saved verified SSH protects this Okou session, not the Mac's listener: other clients may reach port 5900 depending on your network. Enable the Mac option yourself only if you accept that risk.

security.qemuX509SaslHelp: QEMU subtype 263 only. TLS verifies the server before SCRAM; no fallback to PLAIN or subtype 264.
security.serverNameHelp: Optional. Leave blank to verify the certificate against the RFB destination host. Set this only when the certificate uses a different DNS name.
